# Civic Accord: Full Reference

Author and creator: [Aarti S Ravikumar](https://ai-aarti.com/)
School: [Pioneer Charter School of Science II](https://saugus.pioneercss.org)
Website: [Civic Accord](/)
Source code: https://github.com/aartisr/governance-app

## Purpose and limitations

Civic Accord is a civic decision-support prototype powered by the Pareto Governance Engine. It demonstrates how to place evidence, public priorities, local-impact assumptions, and compromise trade-offs beside one another.

The bills, districts, sources, credibility scores, and recommendations in this version are illustrative mock data and simulations. They are not verified real-world forecasts or official legislative records. AI-generated content may be inaccurate. Independently verify primary sources before using an output in a real decision. The project does not claim governmental endorsement, NIST certification, guaranteed political neutrality, or production readiness.

## Workspaces

- [Overview](/)
  The current briefing, featured bill, compromise recommendation, and links to the civic workflow.
- [Video Demo](/demo)
  A nine-chapter browser presentation with optional speech synthesis, chapter navigation, and canvas recording. Narration describes a demonstration, not independently verified performance claims.
- [Bills](/bills)
  Illustrative bills, plain-language sections, sponsor context, comparisons, and evidence links.
- [Voter feedback](/feedback)
  Quadratic preference costing and a limited weekly voice-token budget.
- [Local impact](/impact)
  Illustrative district-specific impact estimates and their assumptions.
- [Compromise analysis](/compromise)
  Candidate amendments compared by utility, minimum faction support, and risk-adjusted scoring.
- [Stakeholder trust](/trust)
  Credibility dimensions covering accuracy, expertise, consistency, and transparency.

## Optional AI endpoint

POST /api/gemini/analyze-policy accepts billTitle, billSummary, topic, and userPrompt. Without a configured server-side Gemini API key, it returns an explicitly labeled simulated analysis. External-service errors may also produce labeled simulated fallback content.

The response contains source, summary, keyRisks, opportunities, stakeholderImpact, and recommendedAmendment. There is no public bill-list or system-summary API in this prototype.
